whatsNew.en-AU:
This update brings improvements throughout TaskNotes:

• A redesigned Scratchpad with capture history, writing and outline modes, and record-link suggestions.
• Easier navigation, view management, and manual task ordering.
• Clearer task completion feedback and better performance with large task lists.
• Improved mobile layouts, keyboard handling, accessibility, and support for larger text.
• Fixes for sign-in and collection authorization.

reviewNotes:
TaskNotes 1.0.3 update

REVIEW ACCESS
No login credentials or sample files are required to review the included demo. On a fresh installation, choose "Try a disposable demo" on the opening screen. This opens an included in-memory collection populated with sample tasks. Demo changes are intentionally discarded when the app restarts. Connecting a persistent mdbase collection is optional and requires the user to authorize access.

CHANGES IN THIS UPDATE
Redesigned Scratchpad capture history, writing and outline modes, record-link suggestions, improved navigation and view management, manual task ordering, large-list performance, mobile keyboard handling, accessibility, and sign-in/authorization fixes.

FUNCTIONS AND AUDIENCE
TaskNotes is a task manager for people who want portable structured Markdown records. Users can capture, edit, complete, search, and reorder tasks; set dates, priorities, recurrence, reminders, and time estimates; use lists, boards, and calendars; attach images; and turn Scratchpad notes into tasks.

OPTIONAL SERVICES
mdbase provides access to an authorized persistent collection and reminder timers. Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification service deliver content-free reminder notifications after explicit opt-in. The disposable demo does not require an account or external collection.

The physical-device recording supplied for the initial 1.0.0 review demonstrates the earlier interface, not this updated build.
